title: A bill to direct the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to impose cost-of-service based rates on sales by public utilities of electric energy at wholesale in the western energy market.

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S1220)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 107-49 Including Amdt. to S. 287.

latest_action.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 107-49 Including Amdt. to S. 287.

summaries.text: Directs the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to impose cost-of-service based rates on sales by public utilities of electric energy at wholesale in the western energy market.Mandates that such imposed cost-of-service based electric energy rates remain in effect until the market for electric energy in the western energy market reflects just and reasonable rates as determined by FERC.
